variants.prompt:
Use case: compositing / identity-preserving banner adaptation.
Input image 1 is the selected OpenCompany artwork. Recompose this exact artwork for a new aspect ratio while preserving its premium warm 3D illustrated character, palette, cat identities, work story and brand. Create ONE complete banner, not a contact sheet, mockup or platform UI. The final look should feel like the same illustrator and same company. Opaque background.

IDENTITIES — exactly eight cats, never merge or duplicate:
Researcher: calico cat, oatmeal cardigan, round glasses, thoughtful analyst. Paw holds a bright cyan token halfway into an illuminated dock marked "TOKENS"; a small comparison notebook is nearby.
Builder: ginger tabby, slate-blue rolled-sleeve shirt over dark tee, focused engineer actively typing at code display, visible code output card.
Grower: white cat with charcoal ear patch, sage blazer and terracotta shirt, confident creative strategist using a stylus at campaign/content screen, visible content output card.
Chief of Staff: tuxedo cat, navy waistcoat, cream shirt and tie, calm upright coordinator holding a slim tabbed calendar-and-checklist folio.
Front Desk: cream colorpoint cat with dark ears, burgundy service blazer and black headset, welcoming professional eye contact with customer.
Treasurer: silver tabby, reading glasses, forest-green waistcoat, precise expression and gaze on payment at terminal.
Boss: stocky grumpy brown Persian, cream muzzle, charcoal suit, gold tie and dollar lapel pin, pointing authoritatively to guide team.
Customer: separate solid blue-gray shorthair cat in teal coat, mustard shoulder bag, at far right receiving work and paying money.

CRITICAL NARRATIVE: Make a physical connected pipeline: Researcher inserts cyan token -> glowing cyan conduit goes to working Builder/Grower -> finished software/content deliverables -> Front Desk hands a cream folder marked "FINISHED WORK" with green check to the customer. Front Desk and customer must BOTH grip this same folder. Simultaneously the customer's other paw hands a green banknote with a prominent "$" to the Treasurer, with customer and Treasurer BOTH gripping this same note. Small terminal/check at Treasurer says "PAYMENT". Customer pays company, never reverse. Keep both shared grips clear with natural anatomy.
Preserve distinguishable professional expressions, no generic baby-cat faces. Keep nameplates readable for each of the six roles, "Boss" and "Customer". Simple exact English text, no gibberish. Clear brand contrast and generous separation. Compress scenery before shrinking the cats. No new roles, extra cats, extra limbs, cropped faces, watermarks, arrows floating over faces or social-platform logos.

OUTPUT COMPOSITION: Wide panoramic 3:1 banner, intended exact export 1500 × 500. Aim for a 1920 × 640 generation canvas. All important text, faces, token insertion, deliverables and both payment/work shared grips MUST be inside the center 72% of canvas height (y=14% to 86%); top and bottom are expendable warm architecture/background. Leave lower-left 24% of width below y=52% as plain warm cream background for a profile-photo overlap. Do not print guides or exclusion boxes.
Move brand into upper-left/center-left within x=8% to 33%, y=16% to 48%. Exact black elegant serif wordmark "OpenCompany". Below it, smaller readable sans serif on two lines: "AI employees, running" and "on your computer." Add a short orange accent rule. Omit the longer secondary tagline for this tight header.
A shallow warm courtyard workplace and silver laptop edge run from about x=29% to 94%. Researcher/token station starts at x=30%, never behind lower-left avatar zone. Builder/Grower/Chief occupy center; boss behind them on a reduced-height mezzanine. The Front Desk/Treasurer/customer exchange is toward x=75%-93%, comfortably inset. A shallow glass canopy, apricot stone, oak counters and a few plants keep continuity with the source. Keep all cats and nameplates within protected center band. Avoid a tall laptop lid or oversized roof. Preserve the complete visual story in this panorama.

Front Desk and Treasurer share the handoffs with the customer at right. Keep all faces, role labels, shared work folder and cash note clearly within the band, with 8% of banner height breathing room above and below. Minimal skylight and arches, attractive lighting and strong silhouettes. This is a deliberate horizontal recomposition, not a squeezed or cropped copy of the source.

Boss peers from immediately behind central employees, not elevated on balcony.

The token station and Researcher begin at x=28%; Builder/Grower/Chief cluster across middle. Front Desk/Treasurer/customer transaction lies at x=72%-91%; leave the last 7% and lower-right corner quiet because platform may trim them. Keep token insertion, all six role personas, boss, customer and BOTH shared folder/banknote contacts. Fit essential content within 10%-88% of the design band's height, using only small laptop rim at bottom. Deliverables and cyan conduit should remain visible on the shallow counter. Give the widest space to transaction clarity. Exact role labels as in source. Compose for readability at only 256px final height, avoid thin detail.
